title: MINORS-2 (user ruling 2026-09-12): M4 - the rival's monologue and the host's message copy are decided by the SAME neighbourhood rule (CompanyMessages.HostCopyWouldBeSuppressed). COVERAGE GAP: the fixture cannot reach the SKIP leg (see notes), so this scenario asserts the NON-SKIP leg - the host IS a recipient, so the monologue must play and the skip line must never appear. M1 (host-stop clock bookkeeping) and M2 (comment cites) have no runtime surface and stay review-verified. NO merger; NO save.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (the host melaus, Client1). MINORS-2 deployed (M1 + M2 + M4 + the rivalmono lever). Levers: rivalstate, rivalsig, rivalfire, rivalnews, rivalmono. FIXTURE HYGIENE: NOTHING is saved.
notes: WHICH RIVAL, AND WHY THE SKIP LEG IS NOT REACHABLE HERE. The skip needs a special rival whose primaryNeighborhood holds a CLIENT business and NO host business. Fixture facts: the host melaus holds 6 seventhstreet (Murray Hill), 15 thirdavenue, 46/32 fifthavenue, 36 thirdstreet, 49 secondstreet; Client1 holds 3 broadwaystreet (Midtown), 20/48/52/56 fifthavenue, 21/46 fourthstreet, 34 fourthavenue. The only neighbourhood where the client holds a business and the host demonstrably holds none is Midtown - and Midtown has NO special rival (T-BATCH1 step 15 note, run 4: ActivateLowDemand threw natively there because GetSpecialRivalByNeighborhood returned null). Fifth Avenue is held by BOTH. Every other client street is in a neighbourhood this fixture does not pin down. So the rival used here is the one in the HOST's own neighbourhood (Murray Hill, proven to have a special rival by T-BATCH1 step 11, which fired result=True), discovered at runtime by the rivalfire capture below because primaryNeighborhood is asset data no lever reports. With the host a recipient the predicate must answer FALSE: the monologue plays, the host copy is KEPT, and the skip line must be absent. COVERAGE GAP: the skip leg itself (monologue swallowed, host copy suppressed, relayed copy delivered on the client) is NOT exercised by this fixture and stays review-verified.

'host copy kept' is the evidence the predicate answered FALSE; the skip line in oracles_absent is the evidence the two patches did not fire.
